govdocs-archive_org-my-truth-edda-mussol: Edda Mussolini Ciano’s My Truth — from the Berserker Books archive — is the Duce’s daughter’s memoir. Her frank pages tell the family’s fall. Her husband Ciano was shot in 1944. The book is a first-hand witness to fascism’s end.
govdocs-archive_org-nsia-CarrollRaymondT: Raymond Carroll’s Third Decade, Vol. 8, No. 5 — July 1992 — is an issue of the JFK research journal. The journal served serious researchers. The file belongs to the assassination archive. The item is a fragment of research history.
govdocs-archive_org-nsia-OPRKing-RayRepo: This item — Who Financed James Earl Ray?, creator unknown — is a file on the King case. Ray’s money trail was a mystery. The question endures. The file belongs to the political archive. The item is a fragment of the record.
